title: Sigma Standards
description: Project-level design + quality standards emitted by Step 3 (Phase E). Consumed by dna_conformance assertions in step-verify-gate to enforce DNA invariants across design steps.

version.description: Schema version — always 1 for this revision.

awardStandard.description: When true, the award-grade CRAFT bar applies to all downstream design steps. Matches references/award-standard.md threshold.

qualityBar.description: Human-readable quality threshold statement, e.g. '95+/100 per step verification schema'.

dnaName.description: The minted Design DNA name (two-word invented codename), e.g. 'Machined Slate'. Must match dnaDoc filename slug.

dnaDoc.description: Repo-relative path to the Design DNA constitution markdown, e.g. 'docs/design/machined-slate-DNA.md'.

uiProfile.description: Repo-relative path to ui-profile.json, or null if not yet emitted. e.g. 'docs/design/ui-profile.json'.

antiSlopRules.description: Project-specific anti-slop rules derived from the DNA's anti-DNA and award-standard tells. Each entry is a plain-English rule whose violation pattern is greppable in generated output. The dna_conformance gate greps each rule's key tell against step outputs.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this file was written by Step 3, or null. Example: '2026-06-15T10:30:00Z'.
